scientific_limitations_integrity: For every odd n>=5, the polytope is QSTAB(complement C_n) using all clique inequalities; volume refers only to the missing cap and ordinary coordinate Euclidean measure; the Gaussian statement is a conditional asymptotic, not an unconditional law. The classical minimally imperfect graph theorem is cited as an input. The newer indecomposability paper was read only in its available abstract and introduction, not all of its full text. Historical priority and independent external validation are not claimed.
title: The simplex integrality defect and Gaussian radial law of odd-antihole clique relaxations
